sentences.en: The Japanese economy continued to grow by more than 5% annually.
sentences.zh: 日本经济继续以每年超过5%的速度增长。

sentences.en: She continued to see him in disregard of my advice.
sentences.zh: 她不顾我的劝告仍然和他见面。

sentences.en: Puffing and panting we continued to run with renewed vigor.
sentences.zh: 我们喘着粗气，带着新的活力继续奔跑。

senses.zh: 继续；逗留；维持原状（continue的过去分词）
